title_zh: 明确志愿者工具入门的监督分工

scenario.label_zh: 新志愿者工具入门的监督安排
scenario.goal_zh: 确认入门活动需要直接监督并约定由指定负责人陪同

context_zh: 社区工坊协调员 Leo 与有经验的工作人员 Asha 安排成年新志愿者的工具入门活动，不教授具体操作方法。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.text: Who will supervise the new volunteers during the tool orientation?

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: I can take that role, but I need to stay with the group rather than answer calls at the front desk.

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.text: Agreed. The workshop rules require direct supervision during this first session.

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: Then could you cover the desk while I lead the orientation?

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.text: Yes. I’ll handle visitors and calls, and I won’t leave you responsible for both places.

sentences.speaker: Asha
sentences.text: That works. I’ll meet the volunteers at the workshop entrance.
